description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Junior Division at the 2009 World Championships. Its attacks pick off the opponent's Benched Pokémon, Gengar's Fainting Spell might Knock Out an opponent's Pokémon at once, and Nidoqueen's Maternal Comfort supports the deck's own Pokémon. The 2009 World Championships were held at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, California, in August 2009.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2009 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
